property_summary: For any admissible call (msg.value = 10 ether, block.timestamp > pastBlockTime and no overflow of pastBlockTime+1), C pays out its whole balance (address(c).balance == 0) exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 and otherwise retains its funds; the mutant inverts this so at multiples of 15 it keeps the funds and at other blocks it drains.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, inverting which blocks trigger the transfer.
